title: PANDA: Protein All-atom Nested-tree Denoising Architecture for End-to-End Generation
one_liner_zh: PANDA提出了一种全原子嵌套树去噪生成架构，实现端到端的蛋白质序列与结构联合设计，并在功能基序支架设计上显著优于现有方法，直接契合蛋白质结构生成与设计课题。
abstract: Deep generative models have expanded the scope of computational protein design, yet most approaches still separate backbone generation from sequence assignment or rely on latent and torsional representations that do not operate directly on all atoms in Cartesian space. We present PANDA, an end-to-end generative architecture that performs denoising in a unified all-atom representation, recovering sequence identity directly from atomic occupancy patterns. By coupling global and local coordinate tracks and introducing a sampling strategy that preserves side-chain geometry, PANDA achieves the highest self-consistency design success across protein lengths among evaluated all-atom methods. For functional design it conditions on pairwise distances between motif atoms rather than fixing their coordinates, allowing the functional atoms to be positioned jointly with the scaffold. On the Atomic Motif Enzyme benchmark, PANDA preserves motif geometry and delivers substantially higher scaffolding success than previous approaches, particularly for larger motifs. PANDA thus provides an efficient route to high-quality all-atom generative design with flexible atomic-level control.
abstract_zh: 深度生成模型扩展了计算蛋白质设计的范围，但大多数方法仍将骨架生成与序列分配分离，或依赖潜在和扭转表示，这些表示不直接在笛卡尔空间中的所有原子上操作。我们提出PANDA，一种端到端的生成架构，在统一的全原子表示中进行去噪，直接从原子占据模式中恢复序列身份。通过耦合全局和局部坐标轨迹，并引入一种保持侧链几何形状的采样策略，PANDA在评估的全原子方法中，跨蛋白质长度实现了最高的自洽设计成功率。对于功能设计，它基于基序原子间的成对距离进行条件化，而非固定其坐标，从而允许功能原子与支架共同定位。在原子基序酶基准测试中，PANDA保持了基序几何形状，并在支架构建成功率上显著高于先前方法，尤其对于较大基序。因此，PANDA为高质量全原子生成设计提供了一条高效路径，并具备灵活的原子级控制能力。
